text:
IndiGo Flight Cancelled: What About ‘On Time’ Promise? Will You Get Refund, Extra Benefits? Will ‘BluChip Loyalty’ Help?
Curated By :
Last Updated:
The chaos started after new Flight Duty Time Limitation (FDTL) rules introduced on November 1, 2025, which increased pilot rest time from 36 to 48 hours.
1/11
IndiGo passengers across India faced havoc in recent days as the airline cancelled over 100–200 flights daily due to crew shortages and other factors.
2/11
The chaos stems mainly from new Flight Duty Time Limitation (FDTL) rules introduced on November 1, 2025, which increase pilot rest time from 36 to 48 hours and restrict late-night landings.
ADVERTISEMENT
3/11
With longer mandatory rest hours, IndiGo struggled to maintain staffing levels, leading to crew shortages and a sharp rise in last-minute flight cancellations.
4/11
Adding to the turmoil were technical glitches at multiple airports, winter schedule changes, poor weather and airspace congestion across major routes.
ADVERTISEMENT
5/11
The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) launched a full investigation, demanding immediate mitigation plans from the airline.
6/11
IndiGo issued a public apology to passengers, promising refunds, rebooking options and temporary schedule adjustments to stabilise operations.
ADVERTISEMENT
7/11
Given the disruptions, IndiGo’s punctuality rate dropped to 67.7% in November 2025, sparking anger across Delhi, Pune and Kolkata airports.
8/11
Amid frustration, many pointed out the irony of IndiGo promoting on-time service while its BluChip loyalty program does not offer any punctuality-based rewards.
ADVERTISEMENT
9/11
BluChip rewards are based only on ticket spending and tier status. Passengers earn no extra points, bonuses or perks if their flight arrives early.
10/11
For cancelled or delayed flights, passengers can visit IndiGo’s website, enter their PNR via “Manage Booking,” and choose either a refund or free rebooking option.
